QuestInfo.name: A Member of the Alliance
QuestInfo.0:
Joining an alliance isn't a decision that can be made alone.
Return to Xuanshan and think it over.
QuestInfo.1:
You returned to watch the students of the Xuanshan School train. 

They were still too young and weak... 

The school needs someone who can protect it when danger strikes. Perhaps joining the Alliance could do just that. 
Return to Ereve and talk to Empress Cygnus.
QuestInfo.2:
You have become a member of the Maple Alliance.
When danger strikes, you should be able to help each other. You vowed to do your best to protect everyone.
